entries.comment: •For tariff headings of goods intended for the service of persons with disabilities needs, the reduced rate applies only on filter bags for liquid filtration collection (3926),Y connectors, venipuncture kit during dialysis (9018), bicarbonate cartridges (2836), titanium binder (9018, 8108)
